method.browser: Headless Chromium /usr/bin/chromium, 390x844 mobile/touch viewport; no WebKit/iOS/Android device
method.sampling: One navigation per pair per network/cache cell; 20 sequential normal/warm navigations. Diagnostic samples, not statistically significant production results.
method.server: Actual local HTTP; no Playwright routing. HTML Cache-Control:no-cache + ETag; static max-age=300. These are controlled server headers, not production headers.
method.normal: 30 ms CDP latency, 2 MiB/s download, 1 MiB/s upload, 60 ms per in-memory SDK read
method.slow: 140 ms CDP latency, 200 KiB/s download, 1 MiB/s upload, 180 ms per in-memory SDK read
method.cold: Source opened, then HTTP cache cleared before target click. Does not clear OS DNS or JIT caches.
method.warm: Target opened and completed, then source opened, then native target click.
method.chart: Actual CDN Chart.js 4.6.1 downloaded outside repository; local HTTP rewrite for identical network shaping.
method.firebase: In-memory SDK replacement served locally instead of production Firebase; no live reads/writes. Fixture uses the repository Nexus.png as avatar.
method.readiness: UI/data markers recorded inside document on animation frame; not delayed by Playwright waiting for the load event.
method.cpu: Union of EvaluateScript/EvaluateModule/FunctionCall/RunMicrotasks/V8.Execute/v8.compile trace intervals on CrRendererMain, from click setup through data and load completion; includes fixture/probes, excludes later chart use.
method.cacheHit: ResourceTiming transferSize=0 and decodedBodySize>0; same-origin controlled server.

sdkQueryComparison.normalization: Only the runtime timestamp last-read boundary is normalized; group/identity constraints, paths, filter operators and operation counts are compared.
